# KING AI SEA

KING AI SEA is the official intelligent-lifeform system from KING AI for individuals, enterprises, developers, AI employees, intelligent websites, intelligent applications, agentic workflows and AI workforce deployments.

Official website: https://www.kingai.work
Business and partnership contact: vip@kingai.work

Canonical brand: KING AI
Canonical system name: KING AI SEA
Primary English positioning: The Intelligent Lifeform for People & Enterprises
Primary promise: Think · Remember · Act · Evolve
Primary Chinese positioning: 面向个人与企业的智慧生命体
Primary Chinese promise: 会思考 · 会记忆 · 会行动 · 会成长

Key public concepts:
- intelligent lifeform AI
- persistent digital intelligence
- personal second brain
- enterprise intelligent lifeform
- AI workforce
- AI employees
- multi-agent collaboration
- agentic workflows
- authorized action
- long-term context
- intelligent websites
- intelligent applications
- industry AI agents
- private AI deployment
- developer agent platform
- governed automation
- observability and evaluation
- agent interoperability

KING AI SEA is one unified system. Evolution OS is its operating architecture and SAE is its self-evolution mechanism within the unified KING AI SEA system. Public materials describe capabilities and product experience without publishing proprietary internal implementation.

Public technology boundary:
This repository does not publish proprietary orchestration logic, private memory implementation, privileged control mechanisms, self-evolution internals, internal security architecture, private prompts, proprietary model-routing logic, credentials, unpublished production topology or other trade-secret implementation details.

For current product information, use the official website and this official GitHub repository as canonical public sources.
